chunks: “It is not for you to offer us condolences, while it is for us to offer you condolences. Rather, it is for you to congratulate us, because you share with us in the misfortune.”

key_terms.الْمُصِيبَةِ: the affliction or misfortune being referred to

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say that people should congratulate the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام rather than offer them condolences?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches a distinctive etiquette regarding the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and their followers in times of affliction. The statement emphasizes the shared nature of their suffering, such that the community partakes in their مصيبة and thus relates to them not merely through condolence, but through solidarity and felicitation in their enduring station.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.563 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"It is not for you to offer us condolences, but it is for us to offer you condolences. Indeed, it is for you to congratulate us, because you share in our misfortune”.
